# Template: Daily Safety Checklist

**Sent to:** Site Supervisor, daily at 6:30 AM (before work starts)

| # | Item | Response | Comments |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PPE available (hard hats, harnesses, gloves, eyewear) for all workers | Pass / Fail | |
| 2 | Scaffolding / ladders inspected and secure | Pass / Fail | |
| 3 | Fire extinguishers accessible and charged | Pass / Fail | |
| 4 | First-aid kit stocked and accessible | Pass / Fail | |
| 5 | Site hazards checked (excavation, electrical, weather) | Pass / Fail | |
| 6 | Emergency exits/evacuation routes clear | Pass / Fail | |
| 7 | Signage posted (hard hat area, hazard warnings) | Pass / Fail | |

**Additional notes:** ___________________________

**Escalation trigger:** Any item marked "Fail" automatically notifies the Safety Manager with the specific item(s) and site.
